h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Junagadh

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Junagadh

items.pText: Junagadh sits at the foot of Mount Girnar, with the Gir forest, home of the Asiatic lion, a short distance away. Children here grow up with the forest close by, which makes a jungle theme a natural choice for a school or resort play area. FunPlay Systems designs and makes playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 350 km away, and sends it to Saurashtra by road.

Our Forestia range is a set of jungle-themed play stations, and other pieces in our catalogue take their shapes from animals and plants. A themed play area gives children a story to play in and gives a school or resort something visitors remember. Saurashtra has hot summers and a monsoon from about June to September, so we suggest galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts for themed pieces too.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Pick one main station as the centrepiece, such as a Forestia play station, and build the rest of the theme around it. Animal spring riders, such as our Dino Rider or Alligator Rider, work well in the toddler corner. Greens, browns and yellows from our roto-moulded shades keep the look consistent. Plant real trees and shrubs at the edges, outside the safe play areas, for shade. Resorts on the Gir side can carry the theme into benches from our Garden Decor range.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 350 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you make jungle-themed playground equipment?
items.a: Yes. Our Forestia range is jungle-themed, and we also make animal spring riders and nature-inspired structures. We can combine them into one themed layout for your site.

items.q: Can resorts near Gir order a themed play area?
items.a: Yes. Share photos of the site and the theme you have in mind. Our design team will suggest pieces and colours and send a layout with the safe play area marked.

items.q: How far is Junagadh from your factory?
items.a: About 350 km from our factory in Vasai. We send the equipment by road and install it through our own team or a dealer in Gujarat. Our team plans the delivery once you approve the layout and quote.
